input.name: record-2-safe
input.source:
---- MODULE Differential ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
CONSTANT Nodes
VARIABLE local
Symm == Permutations(Nodes)
Init == local = [n \in Nodes |-> [term |-> 0, ready |-> FALSE]]
Next == \/ (\E n \in Nodes: local' = [local EXCEPT ![n].term = IF @ < 2 THEN @ + 1 ELSE 0])
        \/ (\E n \in Nodes: local' = [local EXCEPT ![n].ready = ~@])
Safe == \A n \in Nodes: local[n].term <= 2
====
input.config:
CONSTANT Nodes={p0,p1}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
SYMMETRY Symm

input.source:
---- MODULE Differential ----
EXTENDS TLC
CONSTANT Nodes
VARIABLES first, second
Symm == Permutations(Nodes)
Init == /\ first = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE] /\ second = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
Next == \/ (\E n \in Nodes: /\ first' = [first EXCEPT ![n] = ~@] /\ UNCHANGED second)
        \/ (\E n \in Nodes: /\ second' = [second EXCEPT ![n] = ~@] /\ UNCHANGED first)
Safe == /\ first \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN] /\ second \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
SYMMETRY Symm
